packageScripts.name: dev
packageScripts.command: npm run predev && NEXT_IGNORE_INCORRECT_LOCKFILE=1 next dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --turbopack

packageScripts.name: dev:lan
packageScripts.command: npm run predev && NEXT_IGNORE_INCORRECT_LOCKFILE=1 next dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --turbopack

packageScripts.name: prebuild
packageScripts.command: npm run prepare-shared-packages && npm run prepare-env

packageScripts.name: predev
packageScripts.command: npm run prepare-shared-packages && npm run prepare-env && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),d=p.join('.next','dev');fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});const m=p.join(d,'prerender-manifest.json');if(!fs.existsSync(m))fs.writeFileSync(m,JSON.stringify({version:4,routes:{},dynamicRoutes:{},notFoundRoutes:[],preview:{previewModeId:'',previewModeSigningKey:'',previewModeEncryptionKey:''}}))"

packageScripts.name: predev:webpack
packageScripts.command: npm run prepare-shared-packages && npm run prepare-env

packageScripts.name: db:reset
packageScripts.command: supabase db reset && FORCE_LOCAL_DB=1 npm run seed

packageScripts.name: db:reset:remote
packageScripts.command: npx tsx --env-file=.env.remote scripts/reset-remote-db.ts && npx tsx --env-file=.env.remote seed.ts

packageScripts.name: db:reset:staging
packageScripts.command: npx tsx --env-file=.env.staging scripts/reset-remote-db.ts && npx tsx --env-file=.env.staging seed.ts

packageScripts.name: docs:links
packageScripts.command: cd docs && npx --yes -p mint@4.2.942 -p openapi-types@12.1.3 mint broken-links

packageScripts.name: docs:validate
packageScripts.command: cd docs && npx --yes -p mint@4.2.942 -p openapi-types@12.1.3 mint validate

packageScripts.name: docs:verify
packageScripts.command: npm run docs:check && npm run docs:validate && npm run docs:links

packageScripts.name: hooks:install
packageScripts.command: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo 'Git hooks enabled (.githooks)'

packageScripts.name: measure:auth:web
packageScripts.command: AUTH_ENTRY_MEASUREMENT=1 PORT=3101 PERF_TIMING=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_PERF_TIMING=1 playwright test e2e/auth-entry-performance.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1 --reporter=line

packageScripts.name: type-check
packageScripts.command: turbo run type-check && npm run type-check:root

packageScripts.name: use:mobile:remote
packageScripts.command: cp apps/mobile/.env.remote apps/mobile/.env.local && echo 'Switched mobile app to the remote backend in apps/mobile/.env.local'
